'''Corey Faherty''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Milwaukee tournament (20 May)]] on 20 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down with few characters (Operational Enforcement start)]], according to Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ milwaukee-wi-5-20-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
